category_definition: Mutually exclusive: routed=ffn_{gate,up,down}_exps; PLE=per_layer_token_embd and blk.*.ple_*; nonrouted_core=remaining tensors excluding MTP/vision. Routers/shared experts/HC/attention/token and output embeddings are nonrouted_core.

memory_estimates.units: bytes; GiB=1073741824; estimates are storage/cache arithmetic, not measured inference memory
caveats: Packed residency depends on mmap/offload; virtual mapping is not RSS.
Top10 arithmetic assumes one token and 10 distinct experts per layer; batches can select more experts.
PLE sparse rows still incur page, prefetch, and row-cache overhead.
Cache estimates are unpadded, one sequence; dtype, layout, runtime, allocator and sequence count affect actual allocations.
Indexer estimates assume one raw 128-element key per token per full layer before pooling.
QSA top_k=2048 does not itself cap persistent K/V cache at 2048 tokens.
Activations, scratch, graph, staging, dequant buffers, OS page tables and GPU runtime overhead excluded.
No inference allocations or dequantization performed.

tensor_contract.authority: tensors[] is the exact observed checkpoint contract: concrete names, GGML shapes, per-tensor formats, shard index and absolute/relative byte offsets. Not a generic Qwen3Next checkpoint.
tensor_contract.shape_convention: shape_ggml is ne[0]-first, fastest axis first; shape_logical_numpy reverses it for logical values. Quantized storage is packed bytes, not a dense array of that shape.
tensor_contract.routed_expert_storage: Each expert gate/up/down tensor is 3D [input,output,512] in GGML order. Consecutive expert slices are on slowest axis; do not transpose packed blocks.

loader_comparison.scope: Name/shape declaration comparison to local qwen4exp.cpp, not an executed load test. Fused alternatives and runtime remapping not exercised.
loader_comparison.warning: Valid GGUF byte layout does not establish local-loader compatibility. Do not silently invent missing weights.

PLE.hash_constants_storage: Metadata UINT64 arrays, not floating point tensors; preserve exact integers, never float32.

MTP.inference_limit: No MTP in these shards; does not establish absence upstream. Local converter disables MTP export.

vision.inference_limit: Image/video tokens and multimodal chat template do not provide a vision tower/mmproj; separate files not audited.
